svg.text: macos — speed relative to stdio (higher is better)
Apple M4 (10 cores), macOS 26.5.1, Apple clang 17 Release
Cell = throughput / base:stdio throughput for the same scenario and thread count; green is faster, red is slower.
Small grey number = absolute throughput in ops/s. "–" = target not run for that scenario (archive backends are read-only).
